raw.title: METAL GOT SOLID FLAGS: THE PHANTOM CALL
raw.description:
Venom Snake trusted Miller with everything - the cipher, the encryptor, the decryptor, all of it.
Recovering the flag should be as simple as running decryption and reading what comes out.

But Miller's loyalty was never as clean as it looked.
Some things never made it to the tapes - and some things aren't quiet what they say they are.

Trust the binary. Not the man who compiled it. :))))
